description: Create hosted checkout for an existing paylink or a server-approved standalone amount and currency. Reuse the same idempotencyKey for the same order on retries.

amount.description: Positive decimal string for standalone checkout, calculated by trusted server code.

cancelUrl.description: Approved return URL when checkout is cancelled.

clientReferenceId.description: Stable merchant customer or user ID for webhook attribution.

currency.description: Required for standalone checkout. Must match the approved order currency.

customerEmail.description: Optional known customer email. Checkout must collect an email before creating a payment if it is absent.

customerName.description: Optional customer name already known to the merchant.

description.description: Optional customer-facing description of the approved purchase.

expiresInMinutes.description: Checkout lifetime in minutes; defaults to 60.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable retry key, required for standalone sessions and recommended for every order. Reuse with the identical request.

merchantOrderId.description: Stable merchant-side order identifier for reconciliation.

metadata.description: Flat non-secret metadata with string, finite number, or boolean values.

paylinkId.description: Existing paylink ID. Omit amount and currency when supplied; the paylink determines the price.

subscriptionId.description: Existing subscription ID for a paylink-backed session only.

successUrl.description: Approved return URL after checkout. A redirect is not proof of payment.

name: yolfi_checkout_sessions_create
title: Create Yolfi Checkout Session
